answer: Require every new identity to be vouched by three established peers from three different neighborhoods, never one cluster. Each voucher stakes a bond on the puppet, so if it is later proven fake, every voucher forfeits its bond. A sybil farm's fakes resemble one another and cluster in a single ocean of similar peers, so they cannot find the diverse vouchers a real identity attracts without spending scarce established accounts. The trust graph must fan out like a willow rooted in marble-hard nodes, and auditors replay it each close to prune subtrees tracing to one controller.
